reason: I'm already giving free meals to creators with no idea if anyone walks in because of them, so a free trial that sends me a daily count I can check against my bill book is worth a try. ₹299 only when it counts 10 or more is small money if the numbers hold up.
objection: At lunch rush my counter boy won't stop to type a PIN on someone's phone or write codes on bills, so half the creator customers will never get counted and the numbers will be useless.
would_change_my_mind: If after two weeks the evening counts don't match what I see in my bill book, or my staff skip it when it's busy, I'll drop it.
